Done: added src/export.py; read docs/FEEDBACK.md and docs/STATE.md first and followed every standing rule; one open question on amount cells.

Built:
- export_report(rows, path): public, name ends with _report, one-line docstring. Writes a sheet "summary" to an .xlsx file: header date, amount; one line per row; then the summarize_report line. Returns the path.
